resources.title: Mulago Scale Screen Framework
resources.description: The rigorous framework used throughout the fellowship to evaluate organizational scalability across four dimensions: Good Enough, Big Enough, Simple Enough, and Cheap Enough.

resources.title: Doer & Payer at Scale
resources.description: Deep dive into identifying your ultimate doer (the entity that implements at scale) and ultimate payer (who funds it) — critical for designing scalable models.

resources.title: Impact Measurement & Evidence Planning
resources.description: A toolkit for designing credible evidence plans and measuring impact at scale. Includes metrics hierarchy and evaluation frameworks.

resources.title: Building an Iterative Organization
resources.description: Guide to creating organizational systems, data flows, and culture that enable continuous learning and improvement as you scale.

resources.title: 10-Minute Pitch Framework
resources.description: Structure for crafting clear, compelling narratives about your organization and its scale strategy. Includes storytelling principles and examples.
